sloka: राक्षसेन अनुवृत्तया वैदेह्या च पादानि तु ।स समीक्ष्य परिक्रान्तम् सीताया राक्षसस्य च ॥३-६४-३७॥
transliteration: rākṣasena anuvṛttayā vaidehyā ca pādāni tu ।sa samīkṣya parikrāntam sītāyā rākṣasasya ca ॥3-64-37॥

translations.english: Bewildered to see the broken bow and quiver and many splinters of the chariot scattered all over, Rama said to his loving brother Lakshmana:
